State a successor can rely on, each verified by command this session: dev dfd3a82, main 92dccf4; only those two branches exist locally and remotely; ruleset 24218126 active on dev requiring Docs and Tracker integrity, 0 bypass actors, main unruled; working tree clean; tracker reads cleanly; GCLI-1 and GCLI-3 are Done.

Two traps that cost this session time. First, a git push composed with anything at all, including a trailing `; echo`, is refused by guard-composed-push: run it bare. Second, completing a task while checked out on a feature branch and then switching to dev restores the tasks/ copy from dev, producing task_lifecycle_duplicate_identity, which fails every quest command and would have failed the Tracker integrity gate: remove the stale tasks/ file in the same PR that lands the completion.

PROMOTION + RECURRENCE 2026-09-30: dev promoted to main at 4da4a2b (PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#11, auto-marked MERGED 00:12:32Z; evidence: push run 36648751520 completed/success on that exact SHA; landed bare via git push origin origin/dev:main). refs/heads/dev was then deleted again - OPAG-844 second occurrence: PR timeline head_ref_deleted 00:12:33Z, one second after the auto-merge; ls-remote and the branches API both showed only main immediately afterwards. opum-ai/glyph-cli#5 timeline carries the same merged -> deleted -> restored sequence for the 2026-09-29 occurrence, so the mechanism has two timestamped instances and is consistent with delete_branch_on_merge (true in repo settings) acting on the auto-merged dev-to-main promotion PR, whose head branch is dev. Evidence locations measured: the PR timelines carry both deletions and both restorations; the repository events feed carried only this occurrence (DeleteEvent ref dev 00:12:33Z) and not the first, so it is lossy - the timelines are the record. Recovered by recreating refs/heads/dev at the promoted SHA via the GitHub refs API; read back: ls-remote and the branches API show dev (protected) and main both at 4da4a2b; PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#11 timeline records head_ref_restored 00:14:10Z. No setting changed; the fix stays with OPAG-844. The repository-profile paragraph on the dev read-back is updated in the same PR. GCLI-2 implementation remains held for DEC-66.
